summary: Fixed the C04 text-replacement window re-entrancy by porting PlatformInputHandler::replace_all_text into the vendored platform.rs (reaching the input handler with the caller's window and context instead of AsyncWindowContext::update), routing Window::replace_input_text through it with a cx parameter, passing cx from input.rs, and recording the new method and rationale in vendor/PATCHES.md's C04 section.

tests.command: cargo test -p gpui-mcp --lib (21 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored)
cargo tree -p gpui-pre (resolves to vendor/gpui-pre at v0.3.6)
call-path check: platform.rs:1783 defines replace_all_text(&mut self, text, window, cx); window.rs:2344 calls it with (text, self, cx); input.rs:166 passes cx

C01-VENDOR-GPUI-PRE.evidence: Unchanged by this rework: cargo tree -p gpui-pre resolves gpui-pre v0.3.6 to vendor/gpui-pre and the workspace-wide tree resolves no other crate from vendor/; cargo check --workspace exits 0 with no diagnostics.

C03-NODE-BOUNDS-EXPOSURE.evidence: Unchanged by this rework: per-node bounds still resolve through Window::a11y_node_bounds in logical pixels, and the observer tests that assert published bounds pass (cargo test -p gpui-mcp --lib, 21/21).

C05-POINTER-POSITION-PRESERVATION.evidence: Unchanged by this rework: input::tests::synthetic_hover_survives_bounds_changed passes, asserting the synthetic position survives a direct bounds_changed, a platform simulate_resize, and a simulate_scale_factor_change.

C06-TEXT-FALLBACK-STACK.evidence: Unchanged by this rework: text_system.rs keeps fallback_with_requested_traits in resolve_font and the patch type-checks under cargo check --workspace; its unit test remains compile-only because gpui-pre's test target fails on pristine svg_renderer.rs include_bytes! paths to absent Zed workspace assets.

C07-PATCHES-DOCUMENTATION.evidence: vendor/PATCHES.md's C04 section now names both files (platform.rs and window.rs), records PlatformInputHandler::replace_all_text after dispatch_input with its code, the updated Window::replace_input_text(text, cx) body, and the re-entrancy reason: the stock handler wrappers (text_for_range, replace_text_in_range) re-enter the window through AsyncWindowContext::update, so replace_all_text reaches the handler with the caller's window and context instead. The classification header names the document-range probe's new location, and the call-path check confirms the code matches the documentation.

risks: The re-entrancy fix is verified structurally (the new path never calls AsyncWindowContext::update) and by the compile gates; the end-to-end runtime proof is T11's cargo test -p gpui-mcp-html --test runtime.
gpui-pre's test target still fails to compile in this fork (pristine svg_renderer.rs include_bytes! paths to absent Zed workspace assets), so C06's shipped unit test remains compile-only here.

Window::replace_input_text's signature changed to take cx; any caller must pass it. The workspace has no other call sites today, and crates/gpui-mcp-html/tests/runtime.rs (T11's scope) is where the new call lands.
